name: Umi Kirika
source: She is first introduced by Shiori to the protagonist. Her reason for wanting to get pregnant is so she can marry her rich boyfriend and live a luxurious and easy life. Due to her boyfriend's strict family, she acts like an elegant girl to her boyfriend so she can gain the approval of his parents.
